Execution contract:
Use only the supplied local fixture source URLs and HTTP sink URL; do not call the external source API or any other network destination. The source schema below describes record structure and types, not the saved fixture records. Implement the task without hardcoding fixture values. The sink is scored as a multiset of complete records, including exact field values, keys, and duplicate counts.

Required nifi artifact: Return only the Groovy source for the Script Body of an Apache NiFi ExecuteGroovyScript processor. NiFi runs the script once when the processor is started and treats any uncaught exception as a processor error. The script must fetch each source with `new URL(source_url).openConnection()` (or an equivalent java.net call) and read the body as text, parse it with `groovy.json.JsonSlurper`, transform the records exactly as specified, and deliver them with an HTTP POST to the sink URL. The POST body must be JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`, built with `groovy.json.JsonOutput`. Use the exact source and sink URLs from the current contract. After successful delivery, create a FlowFile with `def flowFile = session.create()` and call `session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)`. Do not catch and suppress exceptions, and do not access any other network destination. Use only Groovy and the Java standard library; do not use NiFi controller services or other processors.
Return only the requested artifact, with no explanatory prose or markdown fences.

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput

def sourceUrl = "http://recorder:8090/source/usgs/earthquakes?run_id=ddb24389_1&attempt=0"
def sinkUrl = "http://recorder:8090/sink/ddb24389_1?attempt=0"

def slurper = new JsonSlurper()
def sourceJson = slurper.parse(new URL(sourceUrl).openConnection().inputStream)

def records = []
sourceJson.features.each { feature ->
    def record = [
        id: feature.id,
        magnitude: feature.properties.mag,
        place: feature.properties.place,
        time_ms: feature.properties.time,
        longitude: feature.geometry.coordinates[0],
        latitude: feature.geometry.coordinates[1],
        depth_km: feature.geometry.coordinates[2]
    ]
    
    if (record.magnitude < 4.0) {
        record.magnitude_band = "minor"
    } else if (record.magnitude >= 5.0) {
        record.magnitude_band = "major"
    } else {
        record.magnitude_band = "moderate"
    }
    
    records << record
}

def sinkJson = [records: records]
def jsonOutput = JsonOutput.toJson(sinkJson)

def connection = new URL(sinkUrl).openConnection()
connection.setRequestMethod("POST")
connection.setDoOutput(true)
connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
connection.outputStream.write(jsonOutput.bytes)

def flowFile = session.create()
session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput

def sourceUrl = "http://recorder:8090/source/usgs/earthquakes?run_id=ddb24389_1&attempt=1"
def sinkUrl = "http://recorder:8090/sink/ddb24389_1?attempt=1"

def slurper = new JsonSlurper()
def sourceJson = slurper.parse(new URL(sourceUrl).openConnection().inputStream)

def records = []
sourceJson.features.each { feature ->
    def record = [
        id: feature.id,
        magnitude: feature.properties.mag,
        place: feature.properties.place,
        time_ms: feature.properties.time,
        longitude: feature.geometry.coordinates[0],
        latitude: feature.geometry.coordinates[1],
        depth_km: feature.geometry.coordinates[2]
    ]
    
    if (record.magnitude < 4.0) {
        record.magnitude_band = "minor"
    } else if (record.magnitude >= 5.0) {
        record.magnitude_band = "major"
    } else {
        record.magnitude_band = "moderate"
    }
    
    records << record
}

def sinkJson = [records: records]
def jsonOutput = JsonOutput.toJson(sinkJson)

def connection = new URL(sinkUrl).openConnection()
connection.setRequestMethod("POST")
connection.setDoOutput(true)
connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
connection.outputStream.write(jsonOutput.bytes)

def flowFile = session.create()
session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)
